text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Wilson's disease presenting with hepatic involvement, neuropsychiatric symptoms (behavioral changes, hallucinations), and dysphagia. The family history of early suicide and the specific combination of movement disorders with psychiatric symptoms strongly suggests copper metabolism disorder. I recommend immediate testing for ceruloplasmin and 24-hour urinary copper levels to confirm the diagnosis.
